notes:
Composed of {専|せん} (exclusive) and {売|ばい} (sale). Historically significant in Japan — tobacco, salt, and camphor were once under government monopoly ({専売|せんばい}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧). The Japan Tobacco and Salt Public Corporation ({日本専売公社|にほんせんばいこうしゃ}) managed these until privatization in 1985.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専売|せんばい}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: monopoly system
- {専売|せんばい}{権|けん}: exclusive selling rights
- {専売|せんばい}{品|ひん}: monopoly product, exclusively sold item
- {専売|せんばい}⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧: exclusive patent; figuratively, someone's specialty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧: monopoly — broader term covering market dominance, not just sales
- ⟦{寡占|かせん}→寡占：24627_kasen⟧: oligopoly — market dominated by a small number of sellers
